node.statement: Associativity, amplification, and packaging under def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra: put L_P=P(P(P(X)P(Y))P(Z)) and R_P=P(P(X)P(P(Y)P(Z))). Telescoping replacement of the five map occurrences, using ||T||<=1, ||P||<=M and ||P-T||<=r=M-1, gives ||L_P-L_T|| and ||R_P-R_T|| each at most (M^5-1)||X||||Y||||Z||. Phi_assoc1 and Phi_assoc2 put L_T and R_T within 10eta product of the same T(T(X)T(Y)T(Z)), so ||L_P-R_P||<=(20eta+2(M^5-1)) product. For X,Y,Z in Im(P), L_P=(X star Y) star Z and R_P=X star (Y star Z). Taking the maximum of this error, r, and 3r-r^2 verifies every epsilon-C-star axiom at every matrix level, and the complete self-adjoint operator-space, multiplication and unit therefore satisfy def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra. Since r=O(eta), M^5-1<=31r for 0<=r<=1, and all displayed errors tend to zero, a universal eta_0>0 makes epsilon_AI<1 and epsilon_AI=O(eta), uniformly in n and dim(H).
